purpose: Bounded exploratory final measurement of equal wall-time policy wins and root-worker playing-strength effects.
policy_comparison: Frozen selected RAVE-TS versus UCB, TS and RAVE-UCB. Eight side-reversal pairs per opponent; two workers for both participants.
worker_comparison: Frozen selected RAVE-TS with one, two, four or eight root workers versus a fixed UCB opponent with two workers. Eight side-reversal pairs per condition.
shared_time_protocol: 11x11 boards; 0.25-second native per-move wall-time cap, external 300-second participant game ceiling and 30-second response deadline; 100000-node cap and 128-MB declared memory budget.
opening_rule: One SHA-256-derived forced first move per unique pair seed, identical seed and opening in its side-reversed leg. Coordinates may repeat while seeds and identifiers are disjoint from every existing suite.
host_sharding: Both legs of every pair must run sequentially on the same execution host. Report environment groups separately; avoid overlapping workloads on the same host.
analysis: Report verified completed-game wins, both side-specific counts, failed games by status/actor, and 95-percent cluster-bootstrap intervals over complete side-reversal pairs. Failed games never become playing-strength wins.
interpretation: These supplements were added after the primary final evaluation started. They are exploratory measurements, not additional selection data or a predeclared confirmatory test. Eight pairs per condition can produce wide intervals; avoid small-sample superiority claims. The worker comparison holds wall time and opponent fixed, not total CPU work, and four/eight workers may oversubscribe Kaggle CPU capacity.
stop_rule: Run each scheduled game once, preserving failures. No additional opponents, seeds, time budgets, features, policy selection or worker tuning based on these outcomes.
relationship_to_original_plan: Adds actual equal-time policy and worker win-rate measurements requested by P06-02/P06-03 while preserving primary frozen comparisons and the separate original-source reference.
